correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all facet normals f=(signs,0) or (0,signs) from the cited Proposition 3.4: orthogonal H projection has norm^2=s-(sign sum)^2/N, antipodal facets force centered optimal inradius r. The zero-slack maximal-norm signs span full larger-part coordinates when q odd and sum-zero when q even. With equality constraints on H this yields the claimed affine dimensions and full remaining halfspace inequalities, including the scalar interval for even q; equal parts give zero versus a line segment. Independently recomputed exact rank of active sign normals together with H for 2<=p<=5,p<=q<=7; all agreed. In radius-contact endpoint m=2, constant sign labels are duplicate facets and counted once. Finite rank experiments do not establish the all-size result.
